summary: A fresh, botanical plant care companion for city apartments that tracks every plant by room, schedules watering and misting, identifies new plants by camera and diagnoses problems.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.spec: Three swipeable slides on a soft green background with botanical illustrations. Slide 1 says 'Every plant, on schedule'. Slide 2 says 'Snap to identify any plant'. Slide 3 says 'Diagnose problems in seconds'. Page dots sit at the bottom, and the primary 'Get started' button opens my-plants.

screens.name: My plants
screens.spec: A large title with a soft summary line (7 plants · 2 need water). Below it are room filter chips (All, Living room, Bedroom, Balcony), then a two-column grid of rounded photo cards. Each card shows the plant's nickname, species and a water-due badge coloured water (Today, Tomorrow, In 9 days, or a red Overdue). Tapping a card opens plant-detail, and the primary + button in the top bar opens add-plant.

screens.name: Today
screens.spec: The hero is a green gradient card with a progress ring showing 2 of 5 care tasks done, the date (Thursday, Oct 1) and a 12-day care streak. Below it, tasks are grouped by room (Living room, Bedroom, Balcony). Each row has a checkbox, a plant thumbnail, the action with a palette-coloured icon (water, mist, rotate, fertilize) and the plant name, and tapping a row opens plant-detail. A small 'Coming up this week' section lists tomorrow's and Saturday's tasks.

screens.name: Identify
screens.spec: A dark full-screen camera viewfinder with a rounded white scan frame, corner brackets and a hint ('Center a leaf in the frame'), plus a large shutter button and a gallery button. After a scan, a bottom result card slides up with a photo, the species name (Peace lily, Spathiphyllum wallisii), a 94% confidence bar and two alternates (Anthurium 4%, Calla lily 2%). Its primary 'Add to my plants' action opens add-plant.

screens.name: Profile
screens.spec: An avatar header shows Lena Park, Plant parent · Level 4, with stats for 7 plants, a 12-day streak and 148 tasks done. Below it is a Rooms section of photo cards for Living room, Bedroom and Balcony, each showing its plant count, light level and humidity. The section ends with an 'Add room' button. A settings list follows with reminder time, units, a vacation mode toggle and help.

screens.name: Plant detail
screens.spec: A full-bleed hero photo of Monty the Monstera with its nickname, species (Monstera deliciosa) and room. Next comes a row of needs tiles for light (bright indirect), humidity (60%), water (every 7 days) and temperature. A watering schedule card shows the last and next watering plus a 7-day strip with water, mist and fertilize dots. Below that are a horizontal growth photo timeline (Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, today) and care notes. The primary 'Mark as watered' button sits at the bottom, and a 'Something wrong?' row opens plant-doctor.

screens.name: Plant doctor
screens.spec: A header shows the plant being checked (Monty, Monstera) and a grid of symptom chips with emoji: yellow leaves, brown tips, drooping, spots, pests and leaf drop. Yellow leaves is selected. A diagnosis card follows, showing the likely cause (Overwatering, 82% match) and a short explanation, then numbered recovery steps with checkboxes. The primary 'Add steps to Today' button sends the steps to the today screen.

screens.name: Add plant
screens.spec: A three-step sheet with a progress bar. Step 1 is the species, prefilled as Peace lily with a photo. Step 2 asks for a nickname and room as selectable cards (Living room, Bedroom, Balcony) with light level. Step 3 sets the pot size and when the plant was last watered, then previews the generated care schedule with water, mist and fertilize rows. The primary 'Add Lily' button adds the plant and returns to my-plants.
